title: Measurement
summary: Accuracy, perimeter, circles and sectors, area of shapes and composite shapes, surface area and volume of prisms and cylinders.

cards.title: Errors and accuracy
cards.rule: A measurement is accurate to plus or minus half the smallest unit.
lines: 12 cm to the nearest cm: between **11.5 cm** and **12.5 cm**

cards.title: Length and perimeter
cards.rule: Perimeter is the distance around the outside: add every side.
cards.tip: convert to the same unit before you add.

cards.title: Circumference and sectors
cards.rule: \(C = \pi d = 2\pi r\). A sector is a fraction \(\tfrac{\theta}{360}\) of a circle.

cards.title: Area
cards.rule: Rectangle \(lw\) · triangle \(\tfrac12 bh\) · parallelogram \(bh\) · trapezium \(\tfrac12(a + b)h\) · circle \(\pi r^2\)

cards.title: Composite shapes
cards.rule: Split into shapes you know and add, or take a shape away.
lines: 10 by 6 rectangle with a semicircle on the 6 side: \(60 + \tfrac12\pi(3^2) \approx 74.1\)
cards.tip: the semicircle's radius is half the side: 3, not 6.

cards.title: Surface area of prisms and pyramids
cards.rule: Add the areas of every face. Drawing the net helps.

cards.title: Surface area of cylinders
cards.rule: \(SA = 2\pi r^2 + 2\pi rh\) (two circles plus the curved side).
cards.note: An open cylinder (like a cup) has only one circle.

cards.title: Volume of prisms
cards.rule: \(V = Ah\): area of the cross-section times the length.
lines: 1 cm³ = 1 mL, 1000 cm³ = 1 L, 1 m³ = 1000 L

cards.title: Volume of cylinders
cards.rule: \(V = \pi r^2 h\): the circle's area times the height.
cards.tip: use the radius, not the diameter.
